thread:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Lake Merced overflowed the bike path this morning, had to detour onto 19th Ave. ⚠️ water up to the seat of my bike.
Eric Patel: Yikes. How's the Muni shuttle? thinking of switching to light rail.
Jamie K.: I just got a ping from weather-bot — flash flood warning until 9:30am. Expect slowdowns on SFMTA routes.
weather-bot: Flash Flood Warning active for SW San Francisco until 2026-03-23 09:30 PDT. Avoid low-lying bike paths.
Aisha Gomez: Anyone tried the temporary shuttle from Sunset to Daly City? wondering if it's packed.
Tom H.: I hopped on the shuttle at 8:05 — it’s running but double-length wait, people standing. They announced a detour due to flooded bike lanes.
Maya Chen: Got video of the makeshift detour if someone wants to post in #random-photos. water's covering the painted lane. Sent to @Jamie K.
Jamie K.: posting now → https://imgur.com/a/ExampleFloodPic :sweat_smile: this one looks wild.
Eric Patel: lol wow. glad nobody wrecked. bikers, pls be careful — and maybe consider BART or a rideshare for today.
Aisha Gomez: Heads up to anyone coming to the office: bike racks by the west entrance are partially flooded. Bring extras for parking.
Tom H.: I locked my bike up at the north lot — dryish but soggy. will be late to the 10am sync.
Maya Chen: @here if you're commuting through Sunset, allow an extra 20-30 mins. I’m going remote for the day.
Jamie K.: PSA: If you need to cancel an in-person meeting bc of commute, slack the organizer and add "commute" tag. small thing but saves confusion.
Eric Patel: Also +1 to wearing shoes you don't mind getting wet. :thumbsup:
Aisha Gomez: Someone should ping facilities about a mop for the bike room? floors are wet near the racks.
Maya Chen: Filing a quick ticket to facilities now. @Tom H. want me to add your note about the north lot?
Tom H.: Nah I’m good. Thanks for the heads up and ticket!
Jamie K.: alright back to work, stay dry everyone :umbrella:
